description: Na₂CoPO₄F crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbcn space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.46 Å. There is one shorter (2.36 Å) and one longer (2.62 Å) Na-F bond length. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.84 Å. There is one shorter (2.35 Å) and one longer (2.43 Å) Na-F bond length. Co is bonded to four O and two F atoms to form distorted CoO₄F₂ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CoO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, and  a faceface with one CoO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 68°. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.17 Å. There is one shorter (2.09 Å) and one longer (2.18 Å) Co-F bond length. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent CoO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-53°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.57 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Co, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Co, and one P atom to form distorted ONa₂CoP tetrahedra that share corners with six FNa₄Co₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-76°. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two equivalent Co, and one P atom. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to four Na and two equivalent Co atoms to form FNa₄Co₂ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ONa₂CoP tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent FNa₄Co₂ octahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded to four Na and two equivalent Co atoms to form distorted FNa₄Co₂ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ONa₂CoP tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent FNa₄Co₂ octahedra.
